The route is part of the meaning

A change has somewhere to belong.

The title travels through a declared source route. The web menu has a local contribution, so a story-title change leaves its wording alone. A field without a unique edit route is refused.

The example uses Encounter’s existing compiler, type contracts and patch operation. The inspector uses the shared source lexer and presenter. Both run through the same admitted process algebra.
